digest.linkedin_post_draft: 🚀 Agentic AI is entering a new era of plug‑and‑play skills. This week dozens of ready‑made agent skill libraries landed on GitHub – from genealogy lookup to digital‑human video generation, security‑assessment pipelines, and even a Chinese‑language startup‑founder workflow kit. On top of that, the first agent‑native functional language, ChaosIntelligence, was released, letting developers write agents as true functions rather than long prompt chains. The evidence is clear: multiple repos and new research papers appeared in the last seven days, showing a rapid move toward modular, reusable micro‑services for LLM agents. If you haven’t started experimenting with modular agent skills, now’s the time to dive in.
